# Pending changes (since patch 0021, 2026-11-24)

## 2026-11-24 - The browser's loading screen waits for the world
In a browser the world takes from ~20 s to over a minute to build (measured in Chromium, varying run to run); the loading screen gave up at its 30 s time-out and left a dark screen. There it now waits up to 240 s (LoadVeil.WEB_TIMEOUT), its bar showing, till the game's ready; the desktop keeps 30 s.
Files: scripts/core/load_veil.gd.

## 2026-11-24 - The browser build's worker threads: 8, not 4
Logged in the browser while it loaded: at times the terrain's first 24 patch builds waited 140 s in the queue, none started, while the web build's 4 worker threads (the export's default) were all held by long jobs started at load. The Web preset now has threads/godot_pool_size 8 and threads/emscripten_pool_size 16: three loads in a row in Chromium came in 13-23 s after Start game (were 15-140 s).
Files: export_presets.cfg.
